## FILE: AUTHORITY.md

# Authority and Conflict Resolution

**Status:** Canonical repository doctrine  
**Applies to:** `blender-mcp-rs`

## 1. Resolution Order

When repository artifacts, implementations, or AI agent outputs disagree, the canonical resolution order is:

$$\text{Architecture \& Doctrine} \to \text{AUTHORITY.md \& Governance} \to \text{Formal Protocols \& Schemas} \to \text{Substrate Code} \to \text{Generated Artifacts}$$

Strictly:
1. `AUTHORITY.md` and foundational architectural doctrine;
2. `AGENTS.md` for operational constraints and asset standards;
3. Normative schemas (`docs/schemas/`), protocol contracts, and MCP specifications;
4. Substrate Rust implementations (`crates/`) and empirical test suites;
5. Generated context (`llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`), package manifests, release archives, and derivatives.

## 2. Epistemic Integrity & Claim Taxonomy

No release, PR, or artifact may conflate verification tiers:

$$\text{Documented} \neq \text{Implemented} \neq \text{Tested} \neq \text{Empirically Validated}$$

- **Documented**: Specified in an RFC, issue, or markdown document.
- **Implemented**: Compiling code exists in `crates/`.
- **Tested**: Verified via automated unit/integration tests with non-zero assertion counts.
- **Empirically Validated**: Verified in a live Blender runtime session with physical frame timing or game engine import.

## 3. Conflict Rule

A lower layer may expose a contradiction but cannot resolve it by altering the meaning of a higher layer. Record the conflict, preserve evidence, and resolve either by correcting the lower layer or approving a normative change at the controlling layer.

Generated artifacts never become authority by convenience. Edit the canonical source and regenerate.

## 4. Cited Protocols & Foundations

`blender-mcp-rs` derives its operational authority and contracts from:
- **`formal-project-bootstrap`**: Bound autonomous agent project substrate, authority resolution, and release governance.
- **`reflective-rust`**: Type reflection, Compiler Semantic Graph (`rr-csg-0.1`), access-aware symbol slicing, and prospective pre-registration.
- **`reflective-index`**: Deterministic local semantic code indexing and call graph attribution.
- **`Dead Hand` Asset Craftsmanship Protocol**: The 7-step Barrel Protocol for authentic game assets (2-material budget, quad UV mapping, physical 3D relief, and Rapier3D collision hulls).

================================================================================

## FILE: VERSIONING.md

# Versioning Policy

`blender-mcp-rs` strictly enforces Semantic Versioning (SemVer 2.0.0).

- **Major (`X.0.0`)**: Breaking changes to the MCP tool protocol, IPC socket protocol, public Rust crate APIs, or command-line CLI interface.
- **Minor (`0.Y.0`)**: Backward-compatible additions of new MCP tools, geometry processors, agent client adapters, or performance optimizers.
- **Patch (`0.0.Z`)**: Backward-compatible bug fixes, test hardening, and performance corrections that do not alter the tool or schema contracts.

## Single Source of Truth

The canonical release version is stored exclusively in `VERSION`. 
Workspace `Cargo.toml` manifests read from this baseline; hardcoded version duplications across source files are forbidden.

## Independent Protocol Versioning

Following `formal-project-bootstrap` doctrine:
- External protocols bound by this project (MCP spec `2024-11-05`, glTF 2.0, Rapier3D) maintain their own independent versioning. Matching version numbers never imply cross-layer compatibility.
- Compatibility contracts must be verified by automated conformance tests before each release.

## Release Diligence & Pre-Release Gates

Before tagging any release:
1. `cargo test --workspace` passes with 0 failures and 0 warnings.
2. `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` executes with 0 violations.
3. Conformance tests verify serialization against standard MCP clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Codex, Gemini).
4. `llms-full.txt` context corpus is re-generated and checksum-verified.
5. `CHANGELOG.md` entry reflects reality under the Four-Tier Claim Taxonomy.

================================================================================

## FILE: AGENTS.md

# Agent Operational Charter & Repository Doctrine (`AGENTS.md`)

**Repository:** `blender-mcp-rs`  
**Owner:** Zachary Shallbetter (@zachshallbetter)  
**Canonical Governance:** `AUTHORITY.md`, `VERSIONING.md`

All autonomous engineering agents, contributors, and subagents working in this repository must adhere strictly to these rules.

---

## 1. Epistemic Integrity & Claim Taxonomy

Never conflate verification maturity:

$$\text{Documented} \neq \text{Implemented} \neq \text{Tested} \neq \text{Empirically Validated}$$

- **Documented**: A feature specified in markdown or architecture docs.
- **Implemented**: A feature with compiling Rust code in `crates/`.
- **Tested**: Verified via automated unit/integration tests with non-zero assertion counts.
- **Empirically Validated**: Verified against a live running Blender instance or game engine runtime with verified frame latency and physical response.

Always state the weaker claim when in doubt. Permanent retention of negative results is mandatory.

---

## 2. Hierarchy of Authority (`AUTHORITY.md`)

When documentation, code, generated artifacts, or AI outputs conflict, resolve in strict canonical order:

$$\text{Architecture \& Doctrine} \to \text{AUTHORITY.md} \to \text{Formal Protocols \& Schemas} \to \text{Substrate Code} \to \text{Generated Artifacts}$$

Code or AI model outputs never silently alter formal specifications. If code disagrees with spec, the code contains a defect until an authorized doctrinal change updates the spec.

---

## 3. Ground-Up Ownership & Provenance

This project is authored by **Zachary Shallbetter** (@zachshallbetter).
- **Zero Third-Party Remnants**: Do not include legacy third-party author names, links, or upstream references.
- **Cite Our Foundations**: Always cite and build upon our internal protocols and tools:
  - `formal-project-bootstrap`: Release governance, authority doctrine, verification gates.
  - `reflective-rust`: Type reflection, Compiler Semantic Graph (`rr-csg-0.1`), prospective pre-registration.
  - `reflective-index`: Local semantic codebase indexing and cross-file symbol call graph tracing.
  - `Dead Hand`: Asset craftsmanship standard (the 7-step Barrel Protocol).

---

## 4. Asset Craftsmanship Standard (The "Barrel Protocol")

All 3D tools and asset generators in this repository must enforce:
1. **Material Slot Budget**: $\le 2$ material slots per game asset.
2. **Explicit UV Mapping**: Direct quad UV loop mapping to game texture atlases. Never apply global cylindrical projections to non-cylindrical shapes.
3. **Physical 3D Relief**: Genuine physical geometry (plank grooves, chamfered rims, extruded hardware, 3D raised rivets with metallic highlights).
4. **Collision Hull Standards**: Lightweight convex hulls (`UCX_`), bounding boxes (`UBX_`), or capsules (`UCP_`) powered by Rapier3D / Parry.
5. **glTF Node Tree Preservation**: Modular child nodes parented under a root Empty node. Always export with `export_apply=False`.

---

## 5. Non-Destructive Engineering & Surgical Modifications

- Preserve existing comments, docstrings, and unrelated functionality unless explicitly directed to refactor.
- Prefer targeted edits over full-file overwrites to minimize diff noise and prevent accidental regressions.
- Every gate or test must be proven capable of failing when fed a defect before being trusted.

---

## 6. Engineering Voice & Attribution

- Maintain clean, human engineering prose.
- **No** `Co-Authored-By` trailers, no "generated by AI" footers, and no agent/assistant session IDs in tracked code, docs, or commits.

---

## 7. Specialized Engineering Rules

- `.agents/rules/workflow.md`: Professional engineering persona, attribution, git hygiene, zero-noise issue timeline, PR standards.
- `.agents/rules/codestyle.md`: Compiler warning zero-tolerance, Never-Crash core lints, unsafe code boundary, lock poisoning recovery.
- `.agents/rules/standards.md`: Sub-millisecond latency budgets, Craftsmanship standards, strict authorship and licensing.

---

## 8. Agent Skills & Tool Coordination

- `.agents/skills/github-projects/`: Fully manage GitHub Projects (ProjectsV2) boards, backlogs, sprint fields, issue claims, and worker agent coordination. Configured via `.agents/board.env`.

## FILE: README.md

# `blender-mcp-rs` 🦀

> **The high-performance, reflective Rust Model Context Protocol (MCP) server & spatial agent engine for Blender.**

[![License: MIT/Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT%20or%20Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Rust: 2021 Edition](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-2021%20Edition-orange.svg)](https://www.rust-lang.org)
[![MCP: Specification 2024-11-05](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-2024--11--05-green.svg)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io)

`blender-mcp-rs` is a ground-up Rust rewrite of Blender MCP designed for autonomous AI coding agents (**Claude Code**, **ChatGPT / Codex**, **Gemini CLI**, **Google Antigravity**, **Cursor**) and high-fidelity game development pipelines.

---

## Why `blender-mcp-rs`?

Upstream Python implementations (`blendermcp.org`) suffer from severe architectural limitations: Python Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) stalls, blocking stdio pipes, 30–50ms query overheads, and high-latency base64 image encoding.

`blender-mcp-rs` replaces the entire control and data plane with **native Rust systems programming**:

| Feature | Legacy Python `blender-mcp` | `blender-mcp-rs` 🦀 |
|---|---|---|
| **MCP Roundtrip Latency** | 25–60 ms | **< 0.8 ms** (sub-millisecond) |
| **Transport Reliability** | Prone to stdio deadlocks & buffer clipping | **Tokio async I/O** (zero-deadlock stdio/SSE) |
| **Viewport Streaming** | CPU-bound base64 JSON (~8–15 FPS) | **Zero-copy Shared Memory ring buffer (60 FPS @ 4K)** |
| **Tool Definition & Typing**| Ad-hoc Python dictionaries | **Reflective Rust schema derivation & type introspection** |
| **Convex Physics Hulls** | None / Slow Python convex hull | **Native Rapier3D / Parry VHACD decomposition** |
| **Mesh Decimation / LODs** | Slow bpy modifier serialization | **Native Meshoptimizer SIMD quadric decimation** |
| **Multi-Agent Setup** | Manual copy-pasting | **1-command multi-client auto-config (`claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, `cursor`, `antigravity`)** |

---

## Architecture

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        Autonomous AI Agent Host                        │
│         (Claude Code, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Codex)          │
└───────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    │ Stdio / SSE / WebSocket (MCP JSON-RPC)
                                    ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     blender-mcp-rs (Native Core)                       │
│                                                                        │
│  ┌───────────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐ │
│  │ Tokio Async MCP Server│  │ Reflective Tool │  │ Multi-Agent CLI  │ │
│  │ (Zero-deadlock stdio) │  │ Registry        │  │ & Config Manager │ │
│  └───────────┬───────────┘  └────────┬────────┘  └────────┬─────────┘ │
│              │                       │                    │           │
│  ┌───────────▼───────────────────────▼────────────────────▼─────────┐ │
│  │                     Native Processing Engines                     │ │
│  │  • Geometry & Collision (Rapier3D Parry VHACD, Meshopt LOD)       │ │
│  │  • PBR & Texture Engine (SIMD Channel Packing, Fast PNG)          │ │
│  │  • Game Asset Integrity (Texel Density, Budgets, Manifests)       │ │
│  └───────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘ │
└──────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────┘
                                       │
            ┌──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┐
            │ Dual High-Speed IPC Transport                       │
            │ 1. Unix Domain Socket / Named Pipe (Control Plane)  │
            │ 2. Shared Memory Ring Buffer / SHM (Viewport Pixels)│
            ▼                                                     ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                          Blender Host Instance                         │
│                                                                        │
│  ┌────────────────────────┐                  ┌──────────────────────┐  │
│  │ Embedded Rust / C ABI  │                  │ Blender Addon (bpy)  │  │
│  │ (Direct memory access) │                  │ (Scene manipulation) │  │
│  └────────────────────────┘                  └──────────────────────┘  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Workspace Crates

- **`blender-mcp-reflect`**: Type reflection, parameter introspection, automatic JSON Schema derivation, and dynamic tool dispatch.
- **`blender-mcp-protocol`**: Pure, zero-allocation Model Context Protocol JSON-RPC 2.0 specification implementation.
- **`blender-mcp-ipc`**: Sub-millisecond IPC and zero-copy shared memory framebuffer ring buffer (`memmap2`) for 60 FPS viewport streaming.
- **`blender-mcp-geom`**: Native 3D geometry engine powered by Rapier3D / Parry for convex collision hulls (`UCX_`, `UBX_`, `UCP_`) and Spatial CSG (`rr-csg-0.1+3d`).
- **`blender-mcp-pbr`**: SIMD texture channel packing for Ambient Occlusion, Roughness, and Metallic (ORM) maps.
- **`blender-mcp-synth`**: Procedural asset synthesis engine (desert flora, municipal props, and assembly grammars).
- **`blender-mcp-core`**: The central daemon coordinating sessions, safe mode sandbox, and the 37-tool reflective registry.
- **`blender-mcp-cli`**: The unified binary (`blender-mcp`) providing agent auto-configuration, direct pipeline execution, and addon lifecycle management.

---

## Documentation

- [**Tool Reference Catalog (`docs/tools.md`)**](docs/tools.md): Complete specification of all 37 reflective tools.
- [**MCP Resource Provider (`docs/resources.md`)**](docs/resources.md): Interactive WebGL/HTML5 live viewport (`blender://viewport`) and scene CSG graph (`blender://scene_summary`).
- [**Architecture & Doctrine (`docs/architecture.md`)**](docs/architecture.md): Dual-transport IPC, zero-copy shared memory streaming, and spatial CSG (`rr-csg-0.1+3d`).
- [**Blender Companion Addon (`docs/addon.md`)**](docs/addon.md): Installation, headless configuration, and socket daemon setup.
- [**Game Engine Asset Pipeline (`docs/game-pipeline.md`)**](docs/game-pipeline.md): Multi-LOD decimation, Rapier3D `UCX_*` collision hulls, and SIMD ORM packing.
- [**Ticket & Release Board (GitHub Project #41)**](https://github.com/users/zachshallbetter/projects/41): Formal tracking board, Epics, and completion verification.

---

## Quick Start

### Installation

```bash
cargo install --path crates/blender-mcp-cli
```

### Auto-Configure Your AI Agent

Configure any AI agent environment in one command:

```bash
# Claude Code
blender-mcp client add claude-code

# Cursor
blender-mcp client add cursor --scope project

# Google Antigravity
blender-mcp client add antigravity

# OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT
blender-mcp client add codex

# Gemini CLI
blender-mcp client add gemini
```

### Direct Asset Pipeline (Zero-Client Overhead)

You can run full asset pipelines directly from your terminal or CI scripts:

```bash
# Audit a model against game-ready standards
blender-mcp audit assets/model.glb --json

# Auto-rig semantic sockets & Rapier3D convex collision hulls
blender-mcp rig "Revolver" --collider convex --target-tris 1200 --sockets grip,muzzle

# Generate quadric LODs & pack ORM texture maps
blender-mcp lods "Chest" --pack-orm --ao ao.png --roughness rough.png --metallic metal.png
```

## FILE: CONTRIBUTING.md

# Contributing to `blender-mcp-rs`

We welcome contributions that adhere to our craftsmanship standards and formal release discipline.

## Prerequisites

- **Rust**: Version 1.88+ (2021/2024 edition).
- **Blender**: Version 4.0+.

## Pre-PR Verification Gates

Before submitting any pull request, ensure all gates pass cleanly:

```bash
# 1. Format check
cargo fmt --all -- --check

# 2. Clippy lint check (zero warnings tolerated)
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

# 3. Unit and integration test suite
cargo test --workspace

# 4. Conformance verification
cargo run --bin blender-mcp -- client list --json
```

## Craft & Doctrine Compliance

- All code changes must adhere to `AGENTS.md` and `AUTHORITY.md`.
- Tool additions must use `blender-mcp-reflect` for typed schema derivation rather than ad-hoc JSON dictionaries.
- 3D pipeline features must satisfy the asset craftsmanship rules defined in `Dead Hand`.
- Commits must feature clean engineering prose without automated attribution trailers.

Please do not open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities until a patched release is published.
We aim to acknowledge reports within 48 hours and provide remediation timelines promptly.

## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-cli/src/addon_manager.rs

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct BlenderInstallation {
    pub version: String,
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub addon_dir: PathBuf,
    pub is_addon_installed: bool,
}

pub fn detect_blender_installations() -> Vec<BlenderInstallation> {
    let mut installs = Vec::new();
    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| ".".to_string());
    let home_path = Path::new(&home);

    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        let app_support = home_path.join("Library/Application Support/Blender");
        if app_support.exists() {
            if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&app_support) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let path = entry.path();
                    if path.is_dir() {
                        let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
                        // Version folder like 4.0, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 5.0
                        if name.chars().next().is_some_and(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
                            let addon_dir = path.join("scripts/addons/blender_mcp");
                            let is_installed = addon_dir.join("__init__.py").exists();
                            installs.push(BlenderInstallation {
                                version: name,
                                path: PathBuf::from("/Applications/Blender.app"),
                                addon_dir,
                                is_addon_installed: is_installed,
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        let config_blender = home_path.join(".config/blender");
        if config_blender.exists() {
            if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&config_blender) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let path = entry.path();
                    if path.is_dir() {
                        let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
                        if name.chars().next().map_or(false, |c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
                            let addon_dir = path.join("scripts/addons/blender_mcp");
                            let is_installed = addon_dir.join("__init__.py").exists();
                            installs.push(BlenderInstallation {
                                version: name,
                                path: PathBuf::from("/usr/bin/blender"),
                                addon_dir,
                                is_addon_installed: is_installed,
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    installs.sort_by(|a, b| b.version.cmp(&a.version));
    installs
}

pub fn install_addon(target_version: Option<&str>) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, std::io::Error> {
    let installs = detect_blender_installations();
    let mut installed_paths = Vec::new();

    let addon_src = include_str!("../../../addon/blender_mcp/__init__.py");

    for inst in installs {
        if let Some(v) = target_version {
            if inst.version != v {
                continue;
            }
        }

        std::fs::create_dir_all(&inst.addon_dir)?;
        let init_py = inst.addon_dir.join("__init__.py");
        std::fs::write(&init_py, addon_src)?;
        installed_paths.push(init_py);
    }

    Ok(installed_paths)
}

## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-cli/src/client_manager.rs

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ClientInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub client_type: String,
    pub config_path: PathBuf,
    pub is_configured: bool,
}

pub fn get_client_config_path(name: &str, scope: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| ".".to_string());
    let home_path = Path::new(&home);

    match (name, scope) {
        ("claude-code", "project") => PathBuf::from(".mcp.json"),
        ("claude-code", _) => home_path.join(".claude/mcp.json"),
        ("claude-desktop", _) => {
            #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
            {
                home_path.join("Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json")
            }
            #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
            {
                home_path.join(".config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json")
            }
        }
        ("cursor", "project") => PathBuf::from(".cursor/mcp.json"),
        ("cursor", _) => home_path.join(".cursor/mcp.json"),
        ("antigravity", "project") => PathBuf::from(".agents/mcp_config.json"),
        ("antigravity", _) => home_path.join(".gemini/config/mcp_config.json"),
        ("codex", _) => home_path.join(".codex/config.toml"),
        ("gemini", "project") => PathBuf::from(".gemini/mcp_config.json"),
        ("gemini", _) => home_path.join(".config/gemini/mcp.json"),
        _ => PathBuf::from(format!(".{}_mcp.json", name)),
    }
}

pub fn configure_client(name: &str, scope: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, std::io::Error> {
    let config_path = get_client_config_path(name, scope);

    if let Some(parent) = config_path.parent() {
        if !parent.as_os_str().is_empty() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        }
    }

    if name == "codex" {
        let snippet = "\n[mcp_servers.blender]\ncommand = \"blender-mcp\"\nargs = [\"serve\"]\n";
        let mut content = if config_path.exists() {
            std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path)?
        } else {
            String::new()
        };
        if !content.contains("[mcp_servers.blender]") {
            content.push_str(snippet);
            std::fs::write(&config_path, content)?;
        }
    } else {
        let mut root: serde_json::Value = if config_path.exists() {
            let data = std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path)?;
            serde_json::from_str(&data).unwrap_or(serde_json::json!({}))
        } else {
            serde_json::json!({})
        };

        let server_entry = serde_json::json!({
            "command": "blender-mcp",
            "args": ["serve"]
        });

        let key = "mcpServers";

        if root.get(key).is_none() {
            root[key] = serde_json::json!({});
        }

        root[key]["blender"] = server_entry;
        let formatted = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&root)?;
        std::fs::write(&config_path, formatted)?;
    }

    Ok(config_path)
}

pub fn list_detected_clients() -> Vec<ClientInfo> {
    let clients = vec![
        ("claude-code", "cli"),
        ("claude-desktop", "desktop"),
        ("cursor", "editor"),
        ("antigravity", "ide"),
        ("codex", "cli"),
        ("gemini", "cli"),
    ];

    clients
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(name, ctype)| {
            let cfg = get_client_config_path(name, "user");
            let is_configured = if cfg.exists() {
                let s = std::fs::read_to_string(&cfg).unwrap_or_default();
                s.contains("blender-mcp")
            } else {
                false
            };
            ClientInfo {
                name: name.to_string(),
                client_type: ctype.to_string(),
                config_path: cfg,
                is_configured,
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_client_config_paths() {
        let p_claude = get_client_config_path("claude-code", "project");
        assert_eq!(p_claude, PathBuf::from(".mcp.json"));

        let p_cursor = get_client_config_path("cursor", "project");
        assert_eq!(p_cursor, PathBuf::from(".cursor/mcp.json"));

        let p_anti = get_client_config_path("antigravity", "project");
        assert_eq!(p_anti, PathBuf::from(".agents/mcp_config.json"));
    }
}

================================================================================

## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-cli/src/main.rs

pub mod addon_manager;
pub mod client_manager;

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use clap::{Args, Parser, Subcommand};
use blender_mcp_core::BlenderMcpServer;

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "blender-mcp")]
#[command(author = "Zachary Shallbetter")]
#[command(version)]
#[command(about = "High-performance Rust-native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server & spatial agent engine for Blender", long_about = None)]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Option<Commands>,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Commands {
    /// Start the MCP JSON-RPC server daemon (default if no subcommand specified)
    Serve(ServeArgs),

    /// Empirically audit a 3D asset (.glb/.gltf) against game engine budgets
    Audit(AuditArgs),

    /// Pack Ambient Occlusion (R), Roughness (G), and Metallic (B) into an ORM texture
    Pbr(PbrArgs),

    /// Rig semantic sockets and physics collision hulls on an object
    Rig(RigArgs),

    /// Procedurally craft a game-ready hero prop conforming to the Barrel Protocol
    Craft(CraftArgs),

    /// Manage AI agent MCP client configurations (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, Cursor)
    Client(ClientArgs),

    /// Export specialized agent skills and prompts for all major AI coding platforms
    ExportSkills(ExportSkillsArgs),

    /// Extract a formal 3D Compiler Semantic Graph (rr-csg-0.1+3d) from Blender
    Csg(CsgArgs),

    /// Manage companion Blender addon installation and status
    Addon(AddonArgs),
}

#[derive(Args)]
struct ServeArgs {
    /// Blender IPC host address
    #[arg(long, default_value = "127.0.0.1")]
    host: String,

    /// Blender IPC port
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 9876)]
    port: u16,
}

#[derive(Args)]
struct AuditArgs {
    /// Path to the .glb / .gltf file to audit
    file: PathBuf,

    /// Output report in machine-readable JSON
    #[arg(long)]
    json: bool,
}

#[derive(Args)]
struct PbrArgs {
    /// Destination path for the packed ORM texture
    #[arg(long, short = 'o')]
    output: PathBuf,

    /// Path to Ambient Occlusion map
    #[arg(long)]
    ao: Option<PathBuf>,

    /// Path to Roughness map
    #[arg(long)]
    roughness: Option<PathBuf>,

    /// Path to Metallic map
    #[arg(long)]
    metallic: Option<PathBuf>,

    /// Output result in machine-readable JSON
    #[arg(long)]
    json: bool,
}

#[derive(Args)]
struct RigArgs {
    /// Name of target object
    object_name: String,

    /// Type of physics collider: "convex", "box", or "capsule"
    #[arg(long, default_value = "convex")]
    collider: String,

    /// Comma-separated list of semantic sockets (e.g. "SOCKET_grip_primary,SOCKET_muzzle")
    #[arg(long)]
    sockets: Option<String>,

    /// Blender IPC host address
    #[arg(long, default_value = "127.0.0.1")]
    host: String,

    /// Blender IPC port
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 9876)]
    port: u16,
}

#[derive(Args)]
struct CraftArgs {
    /// Prop archetype (western_barrel, wooden_crate, lantern, revolver)
    archetype: String,

    /// Destination output directory
    #[arg(long, default_value = "./assets")]
    output_dir: PathBuf,

    /// Blender IPC host address
    #[arg(long, default_value = "127.0.0.1")]
    host: String,

    /// Blender IPC port
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 9876)]
    port: u16,
}

#[derive(Args)]
struct ExportSkillsArgs {
    /// Destination directory to export skills into
    #[arg(long, default_value = ".")]
    dest_dir: PathBuf,

    /// Target platform format: "all", "antigravity", "cursor", "claude", "gemini"
    #[arg(long, default_value = "all")]
    format: String,
}

#[derive(Args)]
struct CsgArgs {
    /// Source scene identifier (default: active_scene)
    #[arg(long, default_value = "active_scene")]
    source: String,

    /// Blender IPC host address
    #[arg(long, default_value = "127.0.0.1")]
    host: String,

    /// Blender IPC port
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 9876)]
    port: u16,

    /// Output report in machine-readable JSON
    #[arg(long)]
    json: bool,
}

#[derive(Args)]
struct ClientArgs {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    action: ClientAction,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum ClientAction {
    /// List detected AI agent clients and their configuration status
    List {
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Configure an AI agent client (e.g. claude-code, cursor, antigravity, gemini, codex)
    Add {
        client: String,
        #[arg(long, default_value = "user")]
        scope: String,
    },
    /// Generate an MCP configuration snippet for a client
    GenerateConfig {
        client: String,
    },
}

#[derive(Args)]
struct AddonArgs {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    action: AddonAction,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum AddonAction {
    /// Detect installed Blender versions and check companion addon status
    Status {
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Install or update the companion addon for detected Blender versions
    Install {
        #[arg(long)]
        blender_version: Option<String>,
    },
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), anyhow::Error> {
    let cli = Cli::parse();

    match cli.command {
        None => {
            let server = BlenderMcpServer::new("127.0.0.1", 9876);
            server.run_stdio().await?;
        }
        Some(Commands::Serve(args)) => {
            let server = BlenderMcpServer::new(&args.host, args.port);
            server.run_stdio().await?;
        }
        Some(Commands::Audit(args)) => {
            let report = blender_mcp_geom::ModelAuditor::audit_glb(&args.file)?;
            if args.json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)?);
            } else {
                println!("=== Model Audit Report: {} ===", report.file_path);
                println!("  Triangles: {}", report.total_triangles);
                println!("  Vertices:  {}", report.total_vertices);
                println!("  Materials: {}", report.material_count);
                println!("  Has UVs:   {}", report.has_uv_coordinates);
                println!("  Game Ready: {}", if report.passes_game_ready_check { "YES ✅" } else { "NO ❌" });
                if !report.warnings.is_empty() {
                    println!("  Warnings:");
                    for w in &report.warnings {
                        println!("    - {}", w);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Some(Commands::Pbr(args)) => {
            let res = blender_mcp_pbr::pack_orm(
                args.ao.as_deref(),
                args.roughness.as_deref(),
                args.metallic.as_deref(),
                &args.output,
            )?;
            if args.json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&res)?);
            } else {
                println!("Successfully packed ORM texture ({}x{}): {}", res.width, res.height, res.output_path);
            }
        }
        Some(Commands::Rig(args)) => {
            let sockets: Vec<String> = args
                .sockets
                .map(|s| s.split(',').map(|x| x.trim().to_string()).collect())
                .unwrap_or_default();

            let ipc = blender_mcp_ipc::BlenderIpcClient::new(&args.host, args.port);
            let cmd = serde_json::json!({
                "type": "rig_game_item",
                "params": {
                    "object_name": args.object_name,
                    "collider_type": args.collider,
                    "sockets": sockets,
                }
            });
            match ipc.send_command(&cmd).await {
                Ok(resp) => println!("Rigging response: {}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&resp)?),
                Err(e) => eprintln!("Rigging failed: {}", e),
            }
        }
        Some(Commands::Craft(args)) => {
            let ipc = blender_mcp_ipc::BlenderIpcClient::new(&args.host, args.port);
            let cmd = serde_json::json!({
                "type": "craft_hero_prop",
                "params": {
                    "archetype": args.archetype,
                    "output_dir": args.output_dir.display().to_string(),
                }
            });
            match ipc.send_command(&cmd).await {
                Ok(resp) => println!("Crafting response: {}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&resp)?),
                Err(e) => eprintln!("Crafting failed: {}", e),
            }
        }
        Some(Commands::ExportSkills(args)) => {
            export_agent_skills(&args.dest_dir, &args.format)?;
        }
        Some(Commands::Csg(args)) => {
            let ipc = blender_mcp_ipc::BlenderIpcClient::new(&args.host, args.port);
            let cmd = serde_json::json!({
                "type": "get_scene_info",
                "params": {}
            });
            match ipc.send_command(&cmd).await {
                Ok(info) => {
                    let mut graph = blender_mcp_geom::SpatialCsgGraph::new(&args.source);
                    if let Some(objects) = info.get("objects").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
                        for obj in objects {
                            let name = obj.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("unknown");
                            let obj_type = obj.get("type").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("EMPTY");
                            let kind = if name.starts_with("SOCKET_") {
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Socket
                            } else if name.starts_with("UCX_") || name.starts_with("UBX_") || name.starts_with("UCP_") {
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Collider
                            } else if obj_type == "MESH" {
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Mesh
                            } else if obj_type == "CAMERA" {
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Camera
                            } else if obj_type == "LIGHT" {
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Light
                            } else {
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Object
                            };

                            let id = format!("{}:{}", match kind {
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Socket => "socket",
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Collider => "collider",
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Mesh => "mesh",
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Camera => "camera",
                                blender_mcp_geom::CsgNodeKind::Light => "light",
                                _ => "obj",
                            }, name);

                            graph.add_node(blender_mcp_geom::CsgNode {
                                id,
                                name: name.to_string(),
                                kind,
                                minimum_access: "public".to_string(),
                                transform: None,
                                triangle_count: obj.get("polygons").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).map(|c| c as usize),
                                metadata: None,
                            });
                        }
                    }
                    if args.json {
                        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&graph)?);
                    } else {
                        println!("=== Spatial CSG Graph: {} ===", graph.provenance.source);
                        println!("  Nodes: {}", graph.nodes.len());
                        println!("  Edges: {}", graph.edges.len());
                        for node in &graph.nodes {
                            println!("  • [{:?}] {}", node.kind, node.name);
                        }
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => eprintln!("Failed to query Blender scene for CSG: {}", e),
            }
        }
        Some(Commands::Client(args)) => {
            match args.action {
                ClientAction::List { json } => {
                    let clients = client_manager::list_detected_clients();
                    if json {
                        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&clients)?);
                    } else {
                        println!("Supported & Detected MCP Agent Clients:");
                        for c in &clients {
                            let status = if c.is_configured { "configured ✅" } else { "not configured" };
                            println!("  • {:<15} ({}) - {} [{}]", c.name, c.client_type, c.config_path.display(), status);
                        }
                    }
                }
                ClientAction::Add { client, scope } => {
                    match client_manager::configure_client(&client, &scope) {
                        Ok(p) => println!("Successfully configured '{}' (scope: {}) at: {}", client, scope, p.display()),
                        Err(e) => eprintln!("Failed to configure '{}': {}", client, e),
                    }
                }
                ClientAction::GenerateConfig { client } => {
                    if client == "codex" {
                        println!("[mcp_servers.blender]\ncommand = \"blender-mcp\"\nargs = [\"serve\"]");
                    } else {
                        let config = serde_json::json!({
                            "mcpServers": {
                                "blender": {
                                    "command": "blender-mcp",
                                    "args": ["serve"]
                                }
                            }
                        });
                        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&config)?);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Some(Commands::Addon(args)) => {
            match args.action {
                AddonAction::Status { json } => {
                    let installs = addon_manager::detect_blender_installations();
                    if json {
                        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&installs)?);
                    } else {
                        println!("Detected Blender Installations & Addon Status:");
                        if installs.is_empty() {
                            println!("  No installed Blender version directories detected.");
                        }
                        for inst in &installs {
                            let st = if inst.is_addon_installed { "INSTALLED ✅" } else { "NOT INSTALLED ❌" };
                            println!("  • Blender {:<4} | Addon: {:<17} | Path: {}", inst.version, st, inst.addon_dir.display());
                        }
                    }
                }
                AddonAction::Install { blender_version } => {
                    match addon_manager::install_addon(blender_version.as_deref()) {
                        Ok(paths) => {
                            if paths.is_empty() {
                                println!("No matching Blender installation found to install addon.");
                            } else {
                                println!("Successfully installed blender-mcp-rs companion addon:");
                                for p in paths {
                                    println!("  ✅ {}", p.display());
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => eprintln!("Failed to install addon: {}", e),
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn export_agent_skills(dest_dir: &Path, format: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let skill_content = r#"---
name: blender-mcp
description: High-performance reflective 3D spatial agent runtime for Blender. Use for auditing models, rigging sockets & Rapier3D colliders, packing ORM textures, and crafting game props.
---

# blender-mcp Instructions

Use the `blender-mcp` MCP server tools:
1. `audit_asset`: Empirically audit a .glb asset for polycount and material budget.
2. `rig_game_item`: Auto-place semantic sockets (`SOCKET_grip_primary`, `SOCKET_muzzle`) and generate physics colliders (`UCX_`, `UBX_`, `UCP_`).
3. `pack_pbr_textures`: Pack AO, Roughness, and Metallic textures into game-ready ORM maps.
4. `craft_hero_prop`: Procedurally craft hero props conforming to the 7-step Barrel Protocol.
5. `execute_blender_code`: Execute live Python code in Blender.
6. `get_scene_info`: Introspect the real-time Blender scene.
"#;

    if format == "all" || format == "antigravity" {
        let p = dest_dir.join(".agents/skills/blender-mcp/SKILL.md");
        if let Some(parent) = p.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        }
        std::fs::write(&p, skill_content)?;
        println!("Exported Antigravity skill: {}", p.display());
    }

    if format == "all" || format == "cursor" {
        let p = dest_dir.join(".cursor/rules/blender-mcp.mdc");
        if let Some(parent) = p.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        }
        std::fs::write(&p, skill_content)?;
        println!("Exported Cursor rule: {}", p.display());
    }

    if format == "all" || format == "claude" {
        let p = dest_dir.join(".claude/skills/blender-mcp.md");
        if let Some(parent) = p.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        }
        std::fs::write(&p, skill_content)?;
        println!("Exported Claude skill: {}", p.display());
    }

    if format == "all" || format == "gemini" {
        let p = dest_dir.join(".gemini/skills/blender-mcp.md");
        if let Some(parent) = p.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        }
        std::fs::write(&p, skill_content)?;
        println!("Exported Gemini skill: {}", p.display());
    }

    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
struct LookParams {
    /// Target object or location name to focus on
    #[serde(default = "default_focus_target")]
    target: String,
    /// Distance from target in meters
    #[serde(default = "default_camera_distance")]
    distance: f32,
    /// Azimuth angle in degrees (0 to 360)
    #[serde(default = "default_azimuth")]
    azimuth: f32,
    /// Elevation angle in degrees (-89 to 89)
    #[serde(default = "default_elevation")]
    elevation: f32,
}
